description:
This file is a shell script used for testing git command aliasing, including nested aliases, looping aliases, deprecated built-in aliasing, command formatting, and alias shadowing.
It sets up various alias configurations and executes assertions to verify correct alias behavior within git.

methods.name: can_alias_deprecated_builtin
methods.description: Checks if a deprecated git command can be successfully aliased and invoked.

methods.name: cannot_alias_regular_builtin
methods.description: Verifies that certain regular git commands cannot be shadowed by aliases.

calls: git env GIT_TRACE=1 git echo arg
